comment_text: I live in Connecticut USA in a rural neighborhood. Occasionally, a bear or two will walk through our yards. They are relaxed, non-agressive and leave as quietly as they arrive. We just leave them alone and are honored to share space with them!
These Japanese bears seem much more aggressive than American black bears.

Many may recall the elephants that walked roughly 100 days through China heading to another region they previously inhabited only to encounter humans & concrete.  The people of China understood & didn't harm or harass instead allowing them to travel. When human help was needed it was supplied.  But death was not an option.  The planet was theirs before we were placed here
Reminds me of motivational elders sending their kids to school
We humans have occupied and destroyed their habitat little later non of these beautiful creature will roam this planet.
Time for a tax funded bear patrol.
